notes.title: One year on (& 40% off)
notes.content:
Hello folks,
[i]Amarantus[/i] was released one year ago. It's been a big year:

[list]
[*] Over a thousand copies sold !!
[*] Very Positive on Steam !!
[*] Very on-brand custom emojis and also Steam trading cards!!
[*] Amarantus got reviewed by Eurogamer !!
[*] Amarantus got on two [url=https://noisypixel.net/noisy-pixel-staff-picks-pyre-top-5-games-2023/]GOTY[/url] [url=https://www.videogamesgood.com/post/announcing-video-games-are-good-2023-goty-nominees]lists[/url]!
[*] Amarantus won multiple awards !!
[*] People drew fanart! [url=https://reanimatestar.tumblr.com/post/734680179748847616/been-playing-a-lot-of-amarantus-recently]Meme fanart[/url]! [url=https://purplecritter.tumblr.com/post/754432078401175552/sometimes-a-flower-is-so-thematically-good-that]Flower imagery fanart![/url] [url=https://www.tumblr.com/notomys-mordax-blog/735193782509797376/go-play-amarantus]Family friendly fanart[/url]! Family unfriendly fanart!* The full spectrum of fanart!
[*] We released a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651250/Amarantus__Original_Soundtrack/]soundtrack [/url]! and an [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2798270/Amarantus__Official_Artbook/]artbook[/url]!
[*] The artbook [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199184766874/recommended/2798270/]made people cry[/url]! 
[*] There are, like, multiple full playthroughs of the game on YouTube now, you can go check them out
[*] I got to meet up with other members of the team and we got to hang out IRL and have a nice time :)
[/list]

Thank you for playing, for sharing, for checking it out, for telling people about it. For anything that gave this one little game a little bit of real estate in someone's head for a little bit of time. 

Thinking back to a year ago, there are so many ways I might have imagined feeling now - and most of them were bad. I was determined to be pessimistic pre-launch. 
Instead, thanks to you, and yours, we get to feel satisfied. I don't think there's anything better. Thank you.








*(I won't link this, but it's out there! Someone made money on Patreon off drawing sexy Amarantus characters! What greater success is there!!)

notes.title: The Amarantus artbook & soundtrack are now available!
notes.content:
Hurray! The artbook is here! 

I've spent months chipping away at this project, and I'm so happy to finally get it out to you.

The [i]Amarantus[/i] artbook contains all the comic inserts from the game along with commentary, plus discussions of how some of the game stuff works behind-the-scenes, character discussions + concept art, and other interesting stuff to look at, if you enjoyed [i]Amarantus[/i] and/or are interested in the experience of making a game over ten years.

Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2798270

The soundtrack is now also available on Steam: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2651250

And you can now pick up the game PLUS the artbook PLUS the soundtrack, for a 15% discount:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38079/Amarantus__Game__OST__Artbook/

Thanks for reading! 

- R


P.S. [i]Amarantus[/i] was recently shortlisted at the Queer Games Festival and has just been nominated for the Freeplay Narrative Award. We're honoured and proud (the company we're in for the Narrative Award is truly [b]wild[/b]), and I hope you are vicariously proud too!

notes.title: MacOS & Steam Deck support added!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your support this past month (six weeks, even!) since launch. We're so happy our game found you, and you found it.

Here's our Amarantus V1.1 update for all of you:
[list]
[*][b]MacOS support[/b]! Thank you for your patience, Mac owners. We hope you enjoy.
[*][b]Steam Deck support[/b]! The Steam Deck's earned a bit of a reputation as a Visual Novel Machine so we're excited to have Amarantus running natively on the Deck. (Tip: changing the font size to Large in the Accessibility settings makes for a [i]really[/i] nice experience.)
[*][b]Cross-platform cloud saves[/b]! For those of you who started out on a PC and want to mix it up a bit.
[*][b]Improved controller support[/b]! We've remapped some of the controls and improved the controller experience generally.
[*][b]More save slots[/b]! We've received requests for more save slots to help you get Truly Chaotic with your choices. The number of save slots has now gone from 21 to 39. Get wild!
[*]Minor text and branching tweaks.
[/list]
